home.intro: PQA teacher supervision with the 5T Method: pre-observation, class observation, recommendations and sign-off.

sessions.title: Supervisions
sessions.noInstrument: No active instrument yet. Install the PQA 5T instrument on the Instruments page.
sessions.noTeachers: Add teachers on the school's page first
sessions.emptySchool: No supervisions yet. Press Supervise next to a teacher to start.
sessions.deleteText: Delete {{name}}'s supervision? This cannot be undone.

schools.title: Schools
schools.search: Search schools by name or city
schools.empty: No schools yet. Add the first one.
schools.name: School name
schools.deleteText: Delete “{{name}}” and its list of teachers? Existing supervision reports are kept.

teachers.title: Teachers ({{count}})
teachers.empty: No teachers at this school yet.
teachers.deleteText: Remove {{name}} from the teachers? Their reports are kept.
teachers.pictureHint: Optional. Without a photo, a friendly ustadz or ustadzah figure shows; choose "No picture" to show nothing.
teachers.inReport: This is how it shows in the report.

errors.name: Fill in the name first.
errors.photo: This photo could not be read.
errors.failed: Could not save. Check the connection and try again.
errors.identity: Fill in the teacher's name and the date.
errors.signatures: Sign first, or switch off whoever does not sign.

identity.title: Identity Sheet
identity.intro: Filled in at the pre-observation meeting in the staff room, while looking at the class administration and the teacher's readiness to teach with the 5T Method.

notes.title: Supervisor's Recommendations
notes.intro: Go through the observation with the teacher, clarify the indicators not yet scored, then write the recommendations.
notes.followUpHint: What was not done yet and should be followed up in the next lessons.
notes.clarify: {{count}} indicators are not scored — to be clarified with the teacher, not counted as not done.

sign.title: Sign-off
sign.intro: The supervised teacher and the supervisor sign on this screen.
sign.defaultUsed: Your default signature is used. Clear it to sign again.
sign.off: Does not sign; left out of the report.

report.title: Teacher Supervision Report
report.deleteText: Delete {{name}}'s supervision report? This cannot be undone.

instruments.title: Instruments
instruments.intro: The checklists used to score a supervision. Edit them any time; past reports keep the version they used.
instruments.empty: No instruments yet. Install the PQA 5T instrument from the documents, or build your own.
instruments.deleteText: Delete the instrument “{{name}}”? Reports that used it stay intact.
instruments.name: Instrument name
instruments.active: Active (can be picked for a new supervision)
instruments.versionHint: Every save is a new version. Supervisions already started keep their version.

errors.name: Fill in the instrument's name (Indonesian).
errors.itemText: Every indicator needs its Indonesian text.

instruments.sheetHint: This is how the assessment sheet looks in a report. Click any text to change it.

charts.empty: Shown after the first finished report.

defaults.title: Defaults for every supervision
defaults.intro: The supervisor's name and signature are filled in on every new supervision.
defaults.name: Supervisor's name
defaults.signsHint: Turn off if the supervisor usually does not sign; it can still be changed on each supervision.
defaults.photosHint: Their photo, or the ustadz/ustadzah figure, beside the identity sheet.
defaults.saved: Saved. The next supervisions use these defaults.
